frozen_formation_decision.M2_vs_M0: passed both Brier and log loss gate
frozen_formation_decision.E1_MONTHLY_H1_STRATEGIC_CONTEXT: NOT_SUPPORTED_AS_INCREMENTAL_MODIFIER; retain as strategic context only, exclude from challenge conversion probability
frozen_formation_decision.E2_EMERGENCY_CONTEXT: NOT_SUPPORTED_AS_INCREMENTAL_MODIFIER; retain selective context/confirmation role only, exclude from challenge conversion probability
frozen_formation_decision.E3_GVZ_RISK: NOT_TESTABLE_FORMATION_PIT_NOT_PROVEN; no imputation and no core-window shortening
frozen_formation_decision.SLOW: retain post-break confirmation/new-regime role; do not force into early conversion probability

challenge_input.source_semantic: Twelve Data XAU/USD 1min exact 16:59 America/New_York; no fallback/interpolation

challenge_panel_rules.xau_history: concatenate canonical exact 2021-09..2024-12 prehistory/formation with frozen exact 2025 challenge rows; only VALID_EXACT_BAR observations become governed origins
challenge_panel_rules.event_label: recompute the frozen engine-independent k=3.0 directional-change label continuously from prehistory through 2025; no reset at Jan 1
challenge_panel_rules.FAST: recompute from exact governed history using frozen R4 implementation
challenge_panel_rules.SLOW: recompute from completed W-FRI history using frozen R4 implementation
challenge_panel_rules.MONTHLY_DIRECTION_3M: recompute from prior completed monthly levels only using frozen R4 implementation
challenge_panel_rules.BOCPD_RETURN_SUCCESSOR_V1: map only the prior completed-month native BOCPD state from the frozen successor implementation; no daily replacement
challenge_panel_rules.MACRO_EVENT_SUCCESSOR_V2: read only frozen Macro Event V3 score-series evidence for 2025 and map strong release context to the first governed origin on/after release date under the already frozen event-context mapping; no weak/neutral trigger and no Market Shock requirement for the WP4D probability model
challenge_panel_rules.H1_EXPERTS: available strategic context may be recorded but cannot enter M2 challenge probability because E1 failed formation incremental gate
challenge_panel_rules.EMERGENCY: may be recorded but cannot enter M2 challenge probability because E2 failed formation incremental gate
challenge_panel_rules.GVZ_RISK: NOT_TESTABLE for this frozen model unless already PIT-proven under the formation contract; no new 2025-only promotion

episode_definition.PATH_HALF_role: structural health/anatomy monitoring only; not a probability feature
episode_definition.BREAK_terminal: first later primary k=3 break while episode remains open
episode_definition.RECOVERY_terminal: first governed origin where opener clears before a break
episode_definition.right_censored: exclude from binary probability scoring but report
episode_definition.left_censored_challenge_carry_in: if opener/FAST warning was already active before the first governed 2025 origin, do not credit or probability-score that carry-in episode; ignore it until the relevant signal clears, then score only newly opened 2025 episodes
episode_definition.boundary_reason: a warning first issued in 2024 is not a 2025 challenge-origin prediction and receives no pre-challenge lead credit

frozen_final_fit.fit_data: all 35 core-eligible completed predictive formation episodes only

probability_gate.M2_vs_M0: M2 must strictly improve both Brier score and log loss versus frozen M0 on the exact same challenge episodes
probability_gate.M2_vs_M1: M2 must be no worse than frozen M1 on both Brier score and log loss and strictly improve at least one
probability_gate.AUC_AP: descriptive only and cannot rescue a proper-score failure

monitoring_gate.median_lead_observations: dual lane strictly greater than FAST_CONFLICT
monitoring_gate.note: This reuses the already frozen WP4C challenge burden ceiling and keeps PATH_HALF claim-separated as structural health.

final_decision_rule.accept_if: challenge support passes AND probability gate passes AND monitoring gate passes
final_decision_rule.accepted_claim: retrospective 2025 challenge support for an integrated monitoring core; not production authority and not prospective validation
